requires.daemon_restart: This change only takes effect after the daemon restarts.
requires.net_dns_enable: Local DNS has to be enabled again.
requires.tls_ca_rotate: The local CA has to be renewed for the new TLD.
requires.other: Another action is needed to apply this change.

editor_command.label: Editor command
editor_command.description: Used by “Open in editor”. Use {path}, {line} and {column}. Empty: detects VS Code, PhpStorm or Notepad.

terminal_command.label: External terminal command
terminal_command.description: Used by “Open terminal”. Use {dir} for the folder. Empty: detects Windows Terminal or PowerShell.

terminal_integrated_shell.label: Integrated terminal shell
terminal_integrated_shell.description: Empty: the first one found among pwsh, powershell and cmd.

terminal_max_sessions.label: Integrated terminal sessions
terminal_max_sessions.description: How many sessions can stay open at the same time.

general.saveFailed: The preference could not be saved: {message}

root.label: Root folder
root.description: Where Forgebox keeps tools, sites and data. Read-only.
root.openFailed: The folder could not be opened.

language.label: Language
language.description: Applies to the app and to the tray.

closeToTray.label: Close to tray
closeToTray.description: Closing the window keeps Forgebox in the system tray.

shortcuts.intro: Click a shortcut and press the new combination. Esc cancels.

templates.label: Custom templates folder
templates.description: A file with the same path as a built-in template replaces it.

logs.label: Daemon logs
logs.description: Messages from forgeboxd, including the rotated files.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Checks PATH, DNS, CA, ports and versions, and exports a report.

job.uac: Windows is asking for administrator permission (UAC). Confirm the prompt to continue; this window stays usable.

tld.label: Local TLD
tld.description: Ending of local site names (.test). Reserved for local use, so it never reaches the internet.
tld.invalid: Use a dot and lowercase letters or digits, like .test.
tld.confirmBody: Moving from {from} to {to} changes the name of every site and reissues all certificates: the local CA has to be rotated afterwards and the DNS enabled again. Cancel keeps {from}.
tld.needsRotate: Rotate the local CA so certificates cover the new TLD.
tld.needsDns: Enable the local DNS again for the new TLD.

dns.label: Local DNS
dns.description: Answers any name under the TLD with 127.0.0.1, so sites open without editing hosts.

reasons.group_policy_table_present: A Group Policy NRPT table exists, so Windows ignores local rules.
reasons.resolver_probe_failed: The rule exists, but the Windows resolver did not answer a test name (VPN or security agent intercepting DNS).
reasons.resolver_not_on_port53: The Forgebox resolver is not on port 53, which NRPT requires.
reasons.nrpt_points_elsewhere: Another rule sends the TLD to a different server.

dns.uacNote: Enabling or disabling asks Windows for administrator permission (UAC).

ports.label: Port ranges
ports.description: Where Forgebox picks ports for web servers, databases and pools. Use ports and spans separated by commas.
ports.invalid: Use ports from 1 to 65535 or spans like 3306-3399, separated by commas.
ports.none: The daemon did not list any range.

portMap.label: Ports in use
portMap.description: Read-only: ports Forgebox reserved and other programs sitting on its ranges.
portMap.noExternal: No outside program holds a Forgebox port.

lan.label: Access from the local network
lan.description: Open a site to phones and other computers on the same network.

ca.label: Local CA
ca.description: Certificate authority that signs the HTTPS of your sites. Browsers must trust it once.
ca.subject: Name
ca.installUserNote: Windows shows a security dialog asking to add the certificate to your account. Confirm it.
ca.installMachineNote: Needs administrator permission: Windows shows the UAC prompt and then the certificate dialog.
ca.exportNote: Saves the public certificate (never the key) to import into another browser or machine.
ca.rotateNote: Creates a new CA and reissues every certificate.
ca.rotateBody: This replaces the local CA and reissues every site certificate. Browsers must trust the new CA, and the old one stops working. This cannot be undone.
ca.uninstallNote: Browsers stop trusting the HTTPS of your sites until the CA is installed again.
ca.notInstalledUser: Not trusted by the current user.

certs.label: Certificates
certs.description: One per site, issued by the local CA.

helper.label: Helper log
helper.description: Everything the elevated helper did, newest last. Administrators only.
helper.empty: The helper has not logged anything yet.
